explicitStatement: All 15 production-capability gate criteria pass. The 4 explicitly-assigned residual foundation defects (P1-10, P1-11, P1-3, and the 3 grouped Workstream D sub-tasks: definition-fallback isolation, source-trace identity mismatch, operative-state x structural-health composition) are genuinely remediated with real regression evidence, not merely detection-mitigated or disclosed-and-deferred. This phase is sufficiently closed to proceed to Phase 3F.1.6 Final Foundation Certification.
